text: ①市场普遍预计欧洲央行将加息25个基点，为今年以来第二次加息。 ②市场关注焦点转向官员们对今年晚些时候第三次加息持多大的开放态度。 ③拉加德的新闻发布会措辞将成为市场解读政策方向的关键线索。分析人士认为，拉加德将重申数据依赖的立场，但不会对未来利率路径做出承诺。 ④欧洲央行将同步公布最新的宏观经济预测，市场预计经济增长预测可能小幅上调；通胀预测可能因能源价格而上修，但核心通胀预测预计变化不大。 ⑤关注欧洲央行对美伊冲突、能源价格、债券收益率等的看法。 注：北京时间20:15，欧洲央行公布利率决议；北京时间20:45，欧洲央行行长拉加德召开货币政策新闻发布
text_en: ① The market widely expects the European Central Bank to raise interest rates by 25 basis points, which would be its second hike this year. ② Market focus is shifting to how open officials are to a third rate hike later this year. ③ The wording of Lagarde's press conference will become a key clue for the market in interpreting the policy direction. Analysts believe Lagarde will reiterate a data-dependent stance, but will not commit to the future interest rate path. ④ The European Central Bank will simultaneously release its latest macroeconomic forecasts, and the market expects the economic growth forecast may be slightly revised upward; the inflation forecast may be revised up due to energy prices, but the core inflation forecast is expected to change little. ⑤ Watch the European Central Bank's views on the U.S.-Iran conflict, energy prices, bond yields, and more. Note: At 20:15 Beijing time, the European Central Bank will announce its interest rate decision; at 20:45 Beijing time, European Central Bank President Lagarde will hold a monetary policy press conference.
